resources.string: Break Overlay eye and leaf logo
Rest your eyes. Keep your focus.
A calmer way to use your phone.
Gentle eye breaks and honest daily screen-time awareness — without forcing other apps closed.

Timing depends on Android battery management and manufacturer restrictions. Daily usage is reconstructed from Android UsageStats and may differ slightly from Digital Wellbeing. Break Overlay never closes other apps.
Grant overlay and usage access, then turn monitoring on for gentle, scheduled eye breaks.

A soft interruption after a stretch of focused screen use.
Use 5–240 minutes for breaks and 1–60 for snooze. Common intervals are 20, 30, 45 or 60.
Plays the system notification sound when the overlay appears.
Every eligible foreground app counts toward a break. Launchers, system UI and this dashboard never count.
